question: Because Mr. Cat mumbled that Emilia-tan is bad at making onigiri, now I can’t get the mental image of “Standing behind Emilia-tan as though embracing her with my hands on hers, showing her how to make onigiri, since she can’t do it well and is frustrated” out of my mind, so you’ll have to take responsibility for it.
answer: Understood. I’ll substitute in and look frustrated at being unable to put together onigiri, so please embrace me from behind.
